name: Almunajem Foods Company
summary: Operating within Saudi Arabia, Almunajem Foods Company specializes in procuring, promoting, and supplying a diverse array of frozen, refrigerated, and ambient food products. In addition to food distribution, the company extends its expertise to logistics, providing essential warehousing and transport solutions. Its extensive product portfolio encompasses various categories such as poultry (including chicken and derived products), a range of meats, and dairy items like cheeses, butter, cream, and evaporated milk. Further offerings include French fries, olives and olive oil, seafood, fruits (notably avocado pulp), and basmati rice. These products reach consumers and businesses via wholesale, retail, and dedicated food service channels. The company's broad client base spans the food service sector, serving caterers, airlines, hotels, various restaurant types (fast food, traditional, luxury), cafes, and juice establishments. It also supplies large format retailers like hypermarkets, supermarkets, and superstores, alongside smaller outlets such as mini-markets, baqalas, independent retailers, and directly serves individual purchasers. Established in 1950, Almunajem Foods Company operates from its headquarters in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, functioning as a subsidiary of the Abdullah Ali Almunajem Sons Company.
